# Literature Scan

## Purpose

Scan a bounded supplied source set for material relevant to the objective and acceptance criteria.

## Preconditions

Use a literature-stage bounded Dispatch with network forbidden, one repository, and source artifacts already declared.

## Inputs

Use the objective and criteria, supplied citations and source artifacts, declared context, expected outputs, and checks.

## Procedure

Inspect only declared local sources, extract relevant claims and provenance, record conflicts, gaps, and uncertainty, and avoid unsupported synthesis.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with source-by-source findings plus one pending Proposal that registers or summarizes evidence only when supported.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop when a source is unavailable, outside declared artifacts, unverifiable, or requires network retrieval. Record the gap instead of fetching.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not use network access, expand repositories, fabricate citations, promote Claims, mutate canonical evidence, launch work, or write outside declared paths.
